hooks.name: Format check on save
hooks.description: Early format check (Oxfmt via Vite+) on the saved TS/JS file. Auxiliary aid; the pre-commit `vp staged` and CI `pnpm check` remain the authoritative guards. Does not rewrite files.

action.command: f=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).filePath||'')}catch{}})"); [ -n "$f" ] && pnpm exec vp fmt --check "$f" || true
